body:
Hey there! Writing copy, blog posts, and marketing content is eating up your week—so this edition focuses on AI tools that handle the heavy lifting. Let's cut through the noise and find what actually works for your business.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: small teams already using Notion who want AI integrated into their existing workflow. Free + $10/mo. [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy, social posts, and ad variations in seconds. Best for: solopreneurs and small teams who need quick copy variations without overthinking. Free + $36/mo. [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Optimize your content to actually rank on Google using AI-powered research. Best for: content creators who want to compete in search without hiring an SEO specialist. $89/mo. [Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

## Quick Tip

The biggest mistake? Treating AI output as final. Use these tools as a first draft generator, then spend your time editing for your brand voice and specific details. You're still the expert—AI just handles the blank-page problem faster.

---

**Also worth exploring:** Jasper ($49/mo) if your team needs brand-voice consistency across campaigns, and Writesonic ($19/mo) if you're specifically focused on blog posts and landing pages.

See you next week—stay sharp.
